t: From Printing Press to AI: A New Era of Literacy
s: The evolution from the printing press to AI is fundamentally redefining literacy, transforming expression and creation into executable commands that empower individuals and drive exponential progress through interactive learning and AI-driven assistance.
sub: Programming Literacy as a new form of expression akin to spoken word, distinct from math.
AI as an evolution of tools, lowering barriers and enhancing productivity rather than replacing programmers.
The concept of 'programming literacy' as exemplified by integrated documentation/code environments like Jupyter Notebooks.
Emergent properties in complex systems, from chemical reactions to AI, driven by iterative feedback loops.
